capabilities: Format notes with six built-in templates and adjustable typography, colors and custom template JSON
Learn reusable styles from a public article URL or pasted HTML
Export DOCX, HTML, Markdown and numbered-image packages with embedded media
Synchronize drafts and inline images to platform editors via a companion browser extension
Copy rich text, individual images or Xiaohongshu PNG cards to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a writing or drafting assistant; it formats and transfers already-written notes to platform editors.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed in the manifest. The browser assistant must be installed manually as an unpacked extension from GitHub Actions artifacts, and full real-platform publishing acceptance was still pending at version 0.1.19. Development is supported by an optional WeChat Pay donation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to restyle notes with Chinese-platform typography and move them, with images, into WeChat, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu or X editors without manual copy-paste work.

relations.evidence: Reference sampling uses Juice to resolve CSS selectors and variables

requires.name: X account access for X Articles

summary: Formats Obsidian notes into styled templates for WeChat, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu and X, with image embedding, package export and browser-assisted publishing.
